anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The bigP3BCI PhysioNet dataset curates many P300 speller studies (A–R). Study H is one subset, so this paper is the multi-study parent and not Study H's own data paper.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used in dataset conversion, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI Study H data.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification extension of BIDS used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI Study H data.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec). The experimental paradigm employed a P300 visual oddball task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid and gaze conditions. Single sessions were conducted per subject with target and non-target stimulus presentations. Trial intervals spanned 0 to 1.0 seconds with a 60 Hz line frequency.
